newsitem.title: UK: Cookson rises on bid rumours.
newsitem.headline: Cookson rises on bid rumours.

text.p: Shares in Cookson Plc gained late on Friday as vague bid rumours circulated in the market, dealers said.
The shares rose 19p to 239p by 1610 GMT.
Dealers said a potential bid price of between 270p and 280p had been mooted but dealers said no specific bidder had been named and said they were sceptical about the rumour.
"We've heard there are bid rumours about," said one dealer. "But we think it's a weak rumour as no one has come up with any names as yet."
Another trader said it was "typical Friday afternoon gossip" but added: "If anyone wanted to have a pop at Cookson now could be the time to do it."
Cookson shares fell to a year's intraday low of 206p on November 11.
